text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What's going on? What's with my
running?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Frustration can be a springboard to success.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There's no point in carelessly
overexerting myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry. I wasn't at my best there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Let's get back to it tomorrow. I'm
counting on
you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I've felt regret plenty of times up till
now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Okay then, race strategist. Tell me our
next
move.
